rationale: This empirical survey study analyzes Iowa farmers' attitudes toward proactive targeting of agricultural conservation programs (addressing farm soil erosion and agricultural water quality impacts). It does not involve household or community domestic water or sanitation service access or any domestic service access outcome, warranting exclusion under E07 (wrong service/sector).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings because the study examines Iowa farmers' attitudes toward agricultural soil and water conservation programs rather than household or community domestic water or sanitation service access (E07).

evidence_quotes.quote: Farmer Attitudes toward Proactive Targeting of Agricultural Conservation Programs
Analysis of data on Iowa farmers' attitudes toward targeted conservation indicates that most farmers support targeted approaches.
